<thought>To retrieve the required mapped reaction and template ID, I need to locate the retrosynthetic template that matches the forward Friedel‑Crafts acylation (halide broken, new C–C bond formed). I will search the template catalog using the target product SMILES (constructed from the given precursors) and filter for templates that break a halide. Once I obtain the template ID, I will fetch its SMARTS and map the reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(C(=O)Nc2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
